filter_and_rank.idea: Build an outfit from high-ranked candidates across the relevant kinds, taking the known conditions of her day into account.

anchor_first.idea: Build the outfit around the most striking item in this pool.

tonal_column.idea: Build a coherent column of close tones and let texture sustain it.

ease_the_knot.idea: Keep an outfit idea and solve its tightest spot by changing an item within that kind.

break.idea: Use one item outside the palette intentionally and declare the departure.

free.idea: Use your own distinct ideas and caption each one so that its idea shows.
